landing-header-link: Your additional suggestions for improving the platform
landing-text: Engineering graphics is a crucial tool for simplifying engineering projects and manufacturing processes, increasing accuracy, and enhancing communication
swiper-text-1: The electronic platform for graphic assignments is a comprehensive digital resource designed to facilitate students' independent work on graphic tasks, enhancing the quality of education in engineering graphics. The platform provides comprehensive support for students across all topics covered in the engineering graphics curriculum, ensuring a structured and effective learning experience.
swiper-text-2: The platform includes lecture materials on all topics of engineering graphics, presentations with solutions to exemplary problems, video lessons, and various options for graphic assignments.
swiper-text-3: Using the platform allows students to delve deeper into the materials and study independently, easily learn through theoretical content, video lessons, and presentations, enhance practical skills by completing graphic assignments, self-assess their work, and make the learning process more engaging and effective through interactive materials.
doktorant-desc: Doctoral student of the basic doctoral program at Sharof Rashidov Samarkand State University.
director-desc: Professor of the "Digital Technologies" Department at Tashkent Architectural and Construction University, academic supervisor.
about-lesson-offer-desc-1: Helps students strengthen their theoretical knowledge, gain a deeper understanding of topics, and develop practical skills.
about-lesson-offer-desc-2: It assists students in enhancing their visual learning abilities, making it easier to grasp complex concepts and retain information better.
about-lesson-offer-desc-3: It facilitates a deeper understanding of subjects, allows for the visual perception of challenging concepts, and helps organize the process of independent learning more effectively.
about-lesson-offer-desc-4: It enables students to reinforce their theoretical knowledge through practice, develop self-study skills, and prepare for future engineering activities.
